text:
Alex Morgan: T-minus 45 for the runtime deploy (inference-runtime v3.5). Window 19:00 UTC. I'm the deploy lead. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% over 20m. Quick checklist below — please ack your item. @Priya @Marco @Zoe
Priya Patel: Ack — DB migration flag is OFF and config pins set. I will enable KMS audit logging pre-handoff.
Marco Li: On standby. Smoke scripts uploaded to /ci/smoke and ready. I'll kick off the quick-gen and latency probes after canary starts.
deploy-bot: preflight checks: infra=GREEN, gpu-pools=GREEN, db-locks=NONE, pending-prs=0
Zoe Chen: Quick Q on rollback: if we see p95 latency >5% or error rate >0.5% we revert to v3.4, right? Also how are we handling KV cache warmup?
Alex Morgan: Correct — rollback target is inference-runtime v3.4 (pinned). Rollback runbook is in /runbooks/deploys/runtime-rollback.md. KV cache prewarm command below — run on each shard before traffic ramp:```bash
./tools/prewarm_kv --model rtdb --shards 4 --concurrency 8
```
Priya Patel: I'll flip KMS audit logging now (will post when done). :white_check_mark:
Marco Li: Smoke test plan (post-canary):
1) quick-gen: curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
2) latency probe: python tools/load_test.py --qps 20 --duration 60 --endpoint /v1/generate
I'll run the quick-gen immediately and the 60s probe once canary 1% is confirmed.
Zoe Chen: I'll watch Console route /v1/generate, embeddings pipelines and the tracing view. Alert thresholds set: p50>100ms OR error_rate>0.5% -> notify #eng-oncall and this thread.
Alex Morgan: Owners: - Deploy lead: Alex Morgan - Rollback owner: Priya Patel - Smoke owner: Marco Li - Console monitor: Zoe Chen - On-call: eng-oncall Please react with :white_check_mark: when ready.
Priya Patel: :white_check_mark: KMS logging enabled and verified.
Marco Li: :white_check_mark: smoke scripts ready and permissions verified.
Zoe Chen: :white_check_mark: dashboards up, alerting wired (notice thresholds in Console).
Alex Morgan: Kicking off canary now. Marco, start the quick-gen smoke and paste sample output. I'll watch metrics and be on the pager.
Marco Li: deploy-bot: canary-triggered at 1715000100
Marco Li: running quick-gen smoke now
Marco Li: quick-gen OK — sample response: `{"id":"r1","tokens":12,"latency_ms":78}`
deploy-bot: telemetry: token-usage +2% (expected); error_rate=0.02% ; infra-load normal
Zoe Chen: Metrics clean so far. p95 latency +3% vs baseline; error rate stable. No red flags.
Priya Patel: Ready to cut traffic back within 2 minutes if needed — rollback path validated.
Alex Morgan: Promoting to 10% in 10m if no regressions. Full rollout planned at +30m if steady.
Marco Li: continuing smoke probes every 5m, will post failures immediately.
Zoe Chen: Monitoring continuous — will escalate to #eng-oncall on threshold.
Priya Patel: One note: minor KMS log lag observed (~20s) in staging; not blocking but FYI.
Alex Morgan: Good catch — not blocking the rollout. If we see any auth errors we roll back.
Marco Li: no objections from infra or QA. Proceeding.
Alex Morgan: Thanks all — marking this thread as the handoff record. If anything changes ping here.
Zoe Chen: +1
Priya Patel: +1
Marco Li: +1
